name: com.nesh.mastermemory-debugger
description: Runtime inspection and development override tools for Cysharp MasterMemory v3, built with UI Toolkit. Browse and search tables, override non-key values of existing records in the Editor / Development Builds, and save or export the changed fields as a JSON patch. Requires MasterMemory 3.x installed with NuGetForUnity.

samples.description: Example master tables with IValidatable references, database bootstrap, MasterDataService with TryGetOverride, debugger registration, MasterMemoryDebugRebuild.AutoRebuild and a link.xml template.
